storylines.label: Fable Mythos
storylines.latest_title: Claude Fable 5 on Bedrock Requires Sharing Inference Data with Anthropic

editorial.tldr: Anthropic launched Claude Fable 5 and the higher Mythos 5 tier on Jun 9, billing the Mythos-class model as made safe for general use but shipping it with controversial usage terms. The first sustained hands-on read Fable 5 as "relentlessly proactive." Then on Jun 12-13 the story turned: a US government export-control directive, citing national security, suspended access to Fable 5 and Mythos 5, and coverage recast the launch as models too dangerous to release. A Jun 15 recap framed the takedown as a temporary suspension. By Jun 20 access is back on Amazon Bedrock — but only by opting into provider_data_share, sending prompts and outputs to Anthropic for 30-day retention with human review.

status.detail: Fable 5 and Mythos 5 launched "made safe for general use," were pulled by a US export-control directive, then returned on Amazon Bedrock — but only with provider_data_share, sending prompts and outputs to Anthropic for 30-day retention with human review.

storylines.label: Deep Research
storylines.latest_title: ScaffoldAgent: Utility-Guided Dynamic Outline Optimization for Open-Ended Deep Research

editorial.tldr: Through mid-June, deep research agents kept getting redefined faster than they could be standardized. An arXiv paper argued that benchmarks only grade a single-shot report and miss whether an agent improves under feedback, and ran a multi-turn process-level evaluation. AWS then shipped a build pattern: an end-to-end competitive research agent on Deep Agents and Bedrock AgentCore with isolated multi-step execution. DRFLOW moved the target toward predicting a personalized, enterprise-style workflow rather than just a report, and the latest beat, ScaffoldAgent, attacks the long-form report itself — utility-guided dynamic outline optimization for open-ended deep research.

status.detail: A fast-moving research thread where the success criterion for deep research agents keeps being redefined — evaluation, workflow prediction, and now report-generation structure.

storylines.label: NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Ultra
storylines.latest_title: NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Ultra now available on Amazon SageMaker JumpStart

editorial.tldr: NVIDIA unveiled Nemotron 3 Ultra — a frontier reasoning model — alongside Cosmos 3 and the RTX Spark in early June. Two days later it was available to deploy on Amazon SageMaker JumpStart, where AWS pitched roughly 5x faster inference and 30% lower cost for agentic AI workloads. The thread traces a fast announcement-to-cloud-availability path for a model aimed squarely at agentic reasoning.

status.detail: Announced Jun 2 alongside Cosmos 3 and the RTX Spark; available to deploy on Amazon SageMaker JumpStart by Jun 4.
